limits.singleplayer: Local-slot identity and rewards have portable coverage. Native checks use synthetic actors on a headless authority and two network clients, not two physical split-screen controllers.
limits.compatibility: Vanilla Build 42.21, no dependencies. Modded items match by display name. Dedicated servers match with their own item names and do not load mod translations. Orphaned-item behaviour after removal is unverified.
limits.performance: 32-call batch averages from a 1 ms native clock. Whole-JVM retained heap, not Lua-only allocations. Synthetic 2/16/64 native players test scan scaling, not 64 network connections. One scan per game minute. No per-frame or render hook.
limits.crafting: The craft recipe is verified as a loaded script with one input and one output. A real crafting action was not executed by the native gates.
